{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Explicitly check for missing values in body_mass_g
missing_count = penguins['body_mass_g'].isnull().sum()
print(f'Missing values in body_mass_g: {missing_count}')

# Confirm the shape and data
print(f'Dataset shape: {penguins.shape}')
print(f'Number of non-null body_mass_g: {penguins["body_mass_g"].count()}')

# Drop rows with missing body_mass_g
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['body_mass_g'])

# Compute the mean
mean_body_mass = penguins_clean['body_mass_g'].mean()

print(f'Clean dataset shape: {penguins_clean.shape}')
print(f'Mean body mass (grams): {mean_body_mass}')"}
